A multilayer MRF framework has been introduced in Kato et al. (2002), where a single energy function encapsulates all the constraints of the model, and the result is obtained by a global optimization process in one step. Here, in contrast to decision (Reed et al., 2006) or label (Jodoin et al., 2007) fusion, the observed features are in interaction with the final label map during the whole segmentation process.
